changelog:
OpenClaw Deal Scout 1.0.0 initial release:

- Automates Gmail inbox triage and classifies inbound deal emails using Gemini.
- Logs confirmed deals directly into a free-tier HubSpot CRM.
- Optional instant notifications to Discord via webhook integration.
- Allows reply approvals and sends emails via Gmail API, respecting UK business hours (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 Europe/London, DST-aware).
- Zero hosted infrastructure: runs entirely as a local MCP gateway, storing state as a single JSON file.
- Enforces strict cost controls: only leverages free tiers with no upselling of paid or hosted alternatives.
summary: Autonomous Gmail-to-CRM deal pipeline for solo operators. Classifies inbound deal emails with Gemini, logs them to a free HubSpot CRM, notifies on Discord, and sends approved replies during UK business hours. Zero hosted infrastructure — runs as a single local MCP gateway.
